description: Offre cumulée Bus sur les tronçons routiers is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Description: Couche géographique représentant le réseau routier emprunté par les lignes de bus commerciales régulières autorisées à circuler par Ile-de-France Mobilités avec cumul du nombre de passages par jour.​ Pour trois types de jour (jour de semaine, samedi, dimanche), la couche permet d’identifier les lignes de bus empruntant le tronçon routier considéré avec cumul multi-lignes ... Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Lignes, Horaires théoriques. Its keywords are Offre, Routes, Bus. The portal shows 2026-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
